verdict.rationale: Databricks docs show a governed, no-UI path: the CLI/SDK/REST API authenticate and operate against the platform (databricks-docs-2/48/49, probe-rt-1's `databricks api` wrapper), Unity Catalog governs and can be queried/discovered via CLI, SQL, or REST APIs (databricks-docs-56, 19, 38), and SQL warehouses execute ANSI SQL directly on the lakehouse (databricks-docs-32) — together covering authenticate→discover→query→read entirely outside a dashboard. missing for 10: an explicit end-to-end worked example (e.g., a documented Statement Execution API call returning query results) and independent/hands-on confirmation that an agent can chain these steps without a human touching the UI.
